title: The Believers Laughing at Those Who Mocked Them on the Day of Resurrection
behavior_type: التعامل مع سخرية الأصدقاء من الالتزام
text_original: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا كَانُوا مِنَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا يَضْحَكُونَ * وَإِذَا مَرُّوا بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ * وَإِذَا انقَلَبُوا إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِمُ انقَلَبُوا فَكِهِينَ ... فَالْيَوْمَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ (سورة المطففين: 29-34).
text_simplified: When your child’s friends mock him for his commitment, read with him Surah Al-Mutaffifin (29-34), which describes how the criminals mocked the believers in this world, then the words of Allah: «فَالْيَوْمَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ», interpretation of the meaning: 'So today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers.' The goal is not gloating but to strengthen his conviction that the laughter of others today does not measure the correctness of his stance.
